Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.password

package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.password
Web adapter of the password-based sign-in: the Spring Security user details service over the use case, the password encoder and the authentication provider, which checks the account status only after the password.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web
    Web adapter of the authorization server: security filter chains, login page and OpenAPI description.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    CompromisedPasswordConfiguration
    Registers the CompromisedPasswordCheck port.
    PasswordAuthenticationConfiguration
    Declares the authentication provider of the password-based sign-in, instead of the one Spring Security builds from the UserDetailsService bean, to close a user enumeration.
    PasswordConfiguration
    Registers the password encoder of the password-based sign-in and of the client secrets: new values are encoded with Argon2, while bcrypt and PBKDF2 hashes stay verifiable (and are upgraded on the next successful sign-in).
    PasswordLoginFragment
    Contributes the username and password form to the login page, as every authentication method does through the LoginMethodFragment extension point.
    SpringCompromisedPasswordCheck
    Adapter of the CompromisedPasswordCheck port over Spring Security's CompromisedPasswordChecker (in production, the Have I Been Pwned range API, which only receives a hash prefix of the password).
    SpringPasswordHasher
    Adapter of the PasswordHasher port over Spring Security's PasswordEncoder.
    UserAccountUserDetailsService
    Spring Security UserDetailsService adapter over the FindUserAccountUseCase use case: it maps the domain UserAccount onto Spring Security's UserDetails through the UserDetailsMapper.
    UserDetailsMapper
    Maps the domain UserAccount onto Spring Security's UserDetails.
